national_mandate_scope: Brazilian APS older-person multidimensional assessment / IVCF-20; this does not make the complementary CDC STEADI tests national SUS tests.

falls_checklist.action_rule: seek assessment if any item is answered yes
falls_checklist.adaptation_note: The Caderneta states that the falls check-up is translated/adapted from CDC National Center for Injury Prevention and Control and NCOA.
domains: need to use hands to rise from a chair
urgency when going to the toilet
falls_checklist.software_rule: Do not import a weighted STEADI/NCOA score into the Brazilian Caderneta checklist. Preserve the current national yes/no and any-yes assessment rule.

population.aps_application_rule: apply to all older persons followed by APS

four_meter_gait.role: one IVCF-20 mobility/capacity condition; not a TUG substitute

orthostatic_blood_pressure.brazil_role: Brazilian current record context plus clearly labelled complementary STEADI measurement/interpretation protocol

verified_source_boundaries.finding: The 2026 Brazilian Caderneta presents its 12-item falls check-up as yes/no and directs assessment after any yes response.
verified_source_boundaries.software_rule: Do not reconstruct or import a weighted STEADI/NCOA score into the Brazilian Caderneta layer.

verified_source_boundaries.finding: IVCF-20 includes a 4-m gait condition and fall-history questions; these are not the Timed Up and Go test.
verified_source_boundaries.software_rule: Keep IVCF-20 mobility findings and TUG as distinct instruments.

verified_source_boundaries.finding: The current 2026 Caderneta records blood pressure lying, sitting and standing but does not itself specify the detailed STEADI 5-minute / 1-minute / 3-minute protocol.
verified_source_boundaries.software_rule: Do not label the full STEADI orthostatic protocol as a 2026 Caderneta/SUS rule.

verified_source_boundaries.finding: No current generic federal Brazilian TUG, 30-second Chair Stand or 4-Stage Balance cutoff was identified in the authoritative corpus reviewed.
verified_source_boundaries.software_rule: Expose STEADI thresholds as complementary international guidance, not as national SUS thresholds.

brazil_primary_layer: Caderneta Brasileira da Pessoa Idosa 2026 falls check-up
complementary_layer: CDC STEADI Timed Up and Go
CDC STEADI orthostatic blood pressure assessment
rules: Brazilian national layer must appear before or clearly above complementary STEADI tools.
Do not automatically infer falls risk across different instruments.
Do not merge IVCF-20, the Caderneta falls check-up and STEADI into one synthetic score.
Preserve each instrument's own population, procedure, thresholds and source provenance.
PT-BR is primary; EN-GB is complete informative translation for Brazilian content.
All assessment paths must remain available offline.

negative_finding_policy: A national cutoff is marked not identified only for the authoritative federal corpus reviewed on 2026-09-11; this is not a claim that no Brazilian study or local protocol exists.
